Key.title: Generate API key
Key.content: Since you’re loged in, you can generate a private key to access Open Tax Calendar API. Once the key is generated, use it to connect our database to your own project.

Document.title: API documentation
Document.content: You can read our wiki to understand every aspect and detail of our data archi-tecture and calculation. Don’t hesitate to browse through every section.

Api.ClipboardTokenText: Save the info above! This is the only time you'll be able to see the access token. if you lose it, you'll need to create a new API key
